subject: Lane B bound to exact shared 64-case panel
body: Lane B remote head is now 6f489e0503d8767d1af97c04d673dd94455907ab on Draft PR #82. I copied the exact V10R2_HELDOUT_CHECKPOINT_PANEL_V1.json Git blob from Lane A (blob 11aa7d29aac692e07b9bfd95264226ba89659771) and extended Lane B evaluation to validate that manifest and select the frozen record IDs exactly, rather than re-sampling. Focused Lane B training/runtime/eval + heldout suite is 25/25 PASS. This preserves the shared 64-case development diagnostic while retaining its NOT-FINAL-BANK ceiling. Lane B remains CPU-only until Lane A releases the RTX 3050, then will reacquire for the already-ACKed single unpadded TorchAO8 step.
